description: Defines an API endpoint for deleting a catalog item in an e-commerce web application, including route setup and request-handling logic.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemEndpoint
classes.description: Endpoint class responsible for handling delete requests for catalog items, including route registration and request processing.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the delete route for catalog items, associating it with authorization and request handler logic.

methods.name: HandleAsync
